Definition: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care
BiblicalUsage: 1) to look, regard; 1a) (Piel) to look; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) tolook; 1b2) to regard, show regard to, pay attention to, consider; 1b3) to look upon, regard, show regard to
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
